_comment: Profile: enterprise. Two deployments (forge.review_runtime: separate): POST each entry of `deployments` to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/deployments?beta=true with headers x-api-key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, anthropic-beta: managed-agents-2026-04-01, anthropic-version: 2026-10-21. Create the agents (/v1/agents) and two environments (/v1/environments) first and put their ids below: the cycle environment gets the board and forge tokens and AGENTIC_SDLC_UNATTENDED=1 but never AGENTIC_REVIEW_TOKEN; the review environment gets the same plus AGENTIC_REVIEW_TOKEN. The review runs 15 minutes after each cycle. The shape of initial_events content, budget and the repo resource is not verified: check the Managed Agents docs. Manage: POST /v1/deployments/{id}/pause|unpause|run|archive; runs: GET /v1/deployment_runs.

deployments.agent: <set: agent id from POST /v1/agents; give it the sdlc skill, bash, and the agentic-sdlc MCP server>
deployments.environment_id: <set: cycle environment id; the repo and the binding's env vars as secrets, without AGENTIC_REVIEW_TOKEN>

initial_events.content: <set: the text of templates/runner/cycle-prompt.md below the --- line>

deployments.budget: <set: per-run budget, shape per the Managed Agents docs>

deployments.agent: <set: agent id from POST /v1/agents; give it the sdlc and review-pr skills, bash, and the agentic-sdlc MCP server>
deployments.environment_id: <set: review environment id; the cycle's secrets plus AGENTIC_REVIEW_TOKEN>

initial_events.content: <set: the text of templates/runner/review-prompt.md below the --- line>

deployments.budget: <set: per-run budget, shape per the Managed Agents docs>
